error.title: Template duplication suffixes
error.description:
## Invalid template node suffixes
Loaded templates sharing the same representation are copies of each other. Their top node names must follow the duplication numbering: the first copy is suffixless, the next is `_1`, then `_2`, and so on.
{invalid_nodes}
### How to repair?
Use the `Repair` button on the right. It renumbers the top nodes of each loaded template so their suffixes are contiguous and removes any extra copies beyond the number of loaded templates.
